say:0:1737203101:1.text: A sweet, rich aroma explodes in your mouth as you savor the strange texture of the food.
say:0:1737203101:1.source_cn: 甜蜜馥郁的香气在你的口腔中炸开，你品尝着口中食物奇妙的...
say:0:1737203101:1.male: A sweet, rich aroma explodes in your mouth as you savor the strange texture of the food.
say:0:1737203101:1.female: A sweet, rich aroma explodes in your mouth as you savor the strange texture of the food.

say:1:1737203102:1.text: What is it? It tastes like meat, but smoother. Perhaps a mushroom? But can a mushroom really taste like this?
say:1:1737203102:1.source_cn: 那是什么？吃起来有点像肉，但比肉更细腻滑嫩。或许是蘑菇...

say:2:1737203103:1.text: You can't tell. Clearly, you need to keep sampling...
say:2:1737203103:1.source_cn: 你分不清楚。看来你需要继续更深入地品尝一下……
say:2:1737203103:1.male: You can't tell. Clearly, you need to keep sampling...
say:2:1737203103:1.female: You can't tell. Clearly, you need to keep sampling...

say:3:1737203104:1.text: More sensations flood your senses—so many that you can't tell sweet from sour, bitter from savory. They blend into a symphony in your mind.
say:3:1737203104:1.source_cn: 更多奇妙的口感蜂拥而至，你甚至分不清口感究竟是酸甜苦辣...
say:3:1737203104:1.male: More sensations flood your senses—so many that you can't tell sweet from sour, bitter from savory. They blend into a symphony in your mind.
say:3:1737203104:1.female: More sensations flood your senses—so many that you can't tell sweet from sour, bitter from savory. They blend into a symphony in your mind.

narration:4:1737203105:1.text: The overwhelming sensation makes your head spin. Your vision begins to blur...

narration:4:1737203105:1.female: The overwhelming sensation makes your head spin. Your vision begins to blur...

narration:5:1737203106:1.female: When you open your eyes again, something has changed in the kitchen.
